title: Sorting donations at a toy drive
titleZh: 玩具捐贈活動的分類工作

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Thanks for helping with Saturday's toy drive. Meet at the side entrance of the community hall at ten. Volunteers aged twelve and over can load boxes in the yard. Younger volunteers can sort toys indoors with an adult. If it rains, we'll stop loading in the yard, but the indoor sorting will continue. If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. After that, we'll give unclaimed clipboards to volunteers on the waiting list. If you arrive late, you can still join the sorting with a clipboard you bring. Check that a toy has all its pieces before putting it into a donation box.
turns.zh: 謝謝大家來幫忙星期六的玩具捐贈活動。十點在社區活動中心的側門集合。年滿十二歲的志工可以在院子裝載箱子，較年幼的志工可由成人陪同，在室內分類玩具。下雨的話，院子裡的裝載作業會停止，但室內分類照常。如果預約了寫字板，請最晚十點十五分到接待櫃檯領取。之後，未領的寫字板會交給候補志工。如果你晚到，仍可用自備的寫字板加入分類。請先確認玩具零件齊全，再放進捐贈箱。
